name: wisprflow4agents
description: Watch Wispr Flow notes and folders from Claude Code; the model reads only what its session watches.

browser_ssh_host.title: Browser ssh host
browser_ssh_host.description: When Claude Code runs on a remote machine: the ssh host(s), comma-separated, of the machine whose browser you sign in with. Login then forwards the callback port there for the login's lifetime. Empty: the browser is on this machine. The WISPRFLOW4AGENTS_BROWSER_SSH environment variable overrides it.
